# Weekly Product Pulse — Groww
**Prepared:** 19 Oct 2026 | **Review window:** 27 Jul–18 Oct 2026 | **Analyzed:** 12,995 unique reviews.

**Top themes (keyword-rule buckets):**
- General/mixed feedback: 10,943 (84.2%).
- Trading/order execution: 858 (6.6%).
- Account, KYC & support: 560 (4.3%).
- Fees/charge transparency: 362 (2.8%).
- Stability/performance: 272 (2.1%).

**Verbatim review excerpts (shortened only with ellipses where noted):**
- Fees / charges, 18 Oct, 1★: “worest broker charges to High customer support nill”
- Stability, 16 Oct, 1★: “It very bad app for stock . Because at last moment it technical issues. It doesn't use and coustomer services is not good. bad mutual funds. because my found is...”
- Account / support, 18 Oct, 1★: “worst service, withdrawal amount is not created after 1month also”

**Key observation:** Generic feedback is the largest bucket; specific comments point to trading/order execution, account/support access, and fee transparency. Fee-related comments express customer perceptions and do not by themselves establish an incorrect charge.

**Suggested actions:** Clarify total transaction-cost components before/after trades; review order-execution and stability feedback by app version; make withdrawal status and support escalation easier to understand.

*Method: uploaded export, review-ID deduplication, date validation, existing labels retained for matching IDs, keyword rules applied to newly added reviews. Rule-based labels are not human-verified semantic clustering.*
identified_fee_issue: 338 reviews mention fee/charge keywords; this is not proof of incorrect billing. Comments point to questions about total transaction costs and charge components.
explanation_bullets: **Brokerage is only one line item.** A trade may also include applicable statutory and exchange-related charges; the exact set depends on the transaction and product.
**Check the current pricing page before trading.** Rates and applicable charges can change; use Groww’s official pricing page rather than assuming one flat fee applies to every trade.
**DP charges are distinct from brokerage.** Depository-related charges may apply to delivery sells; check the official help article for when they are levied.
**Review the contract note/transaction details.** Compare each listed charge and its calculation with the official pricing information.
**For a specific unexpected debit,** use the in-app support channel and share the order/contract-note details; do not infer the reason from the total debit alone.
**Last checked:** 19 Oct 2026. This is general information, not investment advice.
